info.name: MedOS Voice AI — Department & Doctor APIs
info.description:
Voice-AI / chatbot integration APIs for MedOS.

**Quick start**
1. Set the collection variables `baseUrl` and (for login) `email` / `password`.
2. Run **Auth › Login** once — it auto-saves the Bearer token into the `token` variable used by every other request.
3. Run **Departments › Get Departments**, then **Departments › Get Doctors in Department** (set the `department` variable, e.g. `Cardiology`).

All data endpoints are Sanctum-authenticated and throttled to 30 req/min. Each token is scoped to one hospital.

request.description: Authenticate and receive a Sanctum bearer token. The test script auto-saves `data.token` into the `token` collection variable, so every other request is ready to run. For production, prefer a long-lived key issued at Admin › Settings › API Keys.

item.name: Booking Flow (rest of the set)

request.description: Look up a patient by phone number. Returns the patient profile + last visit if found, else `success:false`.

query.description: Doctor name, partial or full (fuzzy matched).

request.description: Find a doctor by name (fuzzy match) and return available slots for the next 7 days.

Book an appointment. For an existing patient send `patient_id`; for a new patient send `patient_name` + `patient_phone` (auto-registered). `staff_id` is the doctor UUID from the doctors / doctor-schedule response. Returns the appointment token + confirmed slot.
